long_biography.plain_text:
A visit to London's Tate Gallery at sixteen introduced businessman Erbil Arkın to Rodin's The Kiss and helped inspire his later sculpture collection. Raised in a working-class immigrant family, he paid his way through art and design studies with grants and jobs in shops and restaurants.

He founded the Arkin University of Creative Arts and Design in 2017, seeking to combine academic teaching with students making their own work. His Rodin collection became publicly accessible alongside the university's opening and later moved to a permanent gallery in Kyrenia. Students use the sculptures for close study during courses, and the public can visit free of charge.
